chapters.title: Elijah and King Ahaziah
chapters.summary: Injured King Ahaziah sends to ask Baal-zebub whether he will recover. Elijah intercepts the messengers and declares he will die because he did not ask Israel's God.

chapters.title: Elijah taken up
chapters.summary: Elisha refuses to leave Elijah and asks for a double portion of his spirit. A chariot of fire appears and Elijah goes up by a whirlwind into heaven. Elisha takes up his cloak.

chapters.title: Water in the desert
chapters.summary: Israel, Judah and Edom march against Moab and run out of water. Through Elisha, God fills the valley with water and gives them victory.

chapters.title: Elisha's miracles
chapters.summary: Elisha multiplies a widow's oil, raises the Shunammite woman's son, makes poisoned stew safe, and feeds a hundred men with twenty loaves.

chapters.title: Naaman healed
chapters.summary: Naaman, an Aramean commander with leprosy, is told by an Israelite servant girl about Elisha. After washing seven times in the Jordan, he is healed and confesses Israel's God.

chapters.title: Horses and chariots of fire
chapters.summary: Elisha makes an axe head float. When Aram surrounds him, he prays and his servant sees the hills full of fiery chariots; they that be with us are more.

chapters.title: The siege lifted
chapters.summary: Samaria starves under siege until four lepers discover the Aramean camp abandoned, for God had made the enemy hear a great army. Food is plentiful, as Elisha said.

chapters.title: Elisha and Hazael
chapters.summary: The Shunammite woman's land is restored. Elisha weeps as he foretells that Hazael will become king of Aram and harm Israel. Judah's kings follow Ahab's ways.

chapters.title: Jehu anointed
chapters.summary: A young prophet anoints Jehu king of Israel. Jehu kills King Joram, King Ahaziah of Judah, and Jezebel, as Elijah had foretold.

chapters.title: Jehu destroys Baal worship
chapters.summary: Jehu wipes out Ahab's family and the prophets and worshipers of Baal, but he keeps Jeroboam's golden calves.

chapters.title: Joash saved
chapters.summary: Athaliah seizes Judah's throne and kills the royal family, but baby Joash is hidden in the temple for six years. The priest Jehoiada crowns him and Athaliah is killed.

chapters.title: Joash repairs the temple
chapters.summary: King Joash does right while Jehoiada guides him, and money is collected to repair the temple. Later he pays off Hazael with temple treasures.

chapters.title: Elisha's death
chapters.summary: Israel suffers under Aram. Dying, Elisha has King Jehoash strike the ground with arrows and foretells limited victories. A dead man touching Elisha's bones comes to life.

chapters.title: Amaziah and Jeroboam II
chapters.summary: Amaziah of Judah defeats Edom but foolishly challenges Israel and loses. Jeroboam II restores Israel's borders, for God saw their bitter affliction.

chapters.title: Kings in quick succession
chapters.summary: Azariah reigns long in Judah but is struck with leprosy. In Israel kings are murdered one after another, and Assyria begins to take territory.

chapters.title: Ahaz turns to Assyria
chapters.summary: Ahaz of Judah even sacrifices his son and asks Assyria for help against Israel and Aram. He copies an Assyrian altar for the temple.

chapters.title: The fall of Samaria
chapters.summary: Assyria captures Samaria and carries Israel into exile because they rejected God's covenant and served idols. Foreigners are settled in the land.

chapters.title: Hezekiah trusts the Lord
chapters.summary: Hezekiah removes the idols and trusts God like no king before him. The Assyrian field commander mocks Judah's God outside Jerusalem's walls.

chapters.title: Jerusalem delivered
chapters.summary: Hezekiah spreads Sennacherib's threatening letter before the Lord and prays. Isaiah answers with God's promise, and the angel of the Lord strikes the Assyrian army.

chapters.title: Hezekiah's illness
chapters.summary: God adds fifteen years to Hezekiah's life and makes the shadow go back on the stairway. Hezekiah proudly shows Babylonian envoys his treasures, and Isaiah foretells exile.

chapters.title: Manasseh's evil
chapters.summary: Manasseh rebuilds pagan altars, sacrifices his son and sheds much innocent blood. God announces that Jerusalem will be wiped like a dish.

chapters.title: The book of the law found
chapters.summary: During temple repairs under young King Josiah, the book of the law is found. Josiah tears his robes, and the prophetess Huldah confirms judgment but promises him peace.

chapters.title: Josiah's reforms
chapters.summary: Josiah reads the covenant to the people, destroys idols throughout the land, and keeps a great Passover. No king turned to the Lord like him, yet he dies in battle.

chapters.title: Babylon rises
chapters.summary: Judah becomes subject to Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon. King Jehoiachin, the royal family and the leading people are taken into exile.

chapters.title: Jerusalem falls
chapters.summary: Babylon besieges Jerusalem, burns the temple and the city, and carries the people into exile. Years later Jehoiachin is released and eats at the king of Babylon's table.
